_comment: FailProducts — read-only MCP profile. The daily driver.
Copy to .mcp.json at the repository root (git-ignored) and supply credentials
through your environment. This file contains PLACEHOLDER NAMES ONLY.
Never put a token, account ID, Neon endpoint, or connection string in here.
See mcp/README.md for the permission model.

github._use: Repository, issues, PRs, commits, CI status. Read-only token.

shadcn._use: Component discovery and registry search. No credential required.

playwright._use: Real-browser verification against local or preview. Never production.
